scenario.name: sybil-swarm
scenario.description: 6 vetted sybils vouch each other in a ring with NO founder edge. Anchoring zeroes their trust, but the PoAW faucet + neutral priors still floor the swarm at ~30% aggregate share — the residual leak to close.
